claim: The new DEFAULT-unwrapping branch requires resolvedValue to be an Array, so it can never fire for the plain-object namespace-root case its own comment describes, meaning theme('shadow')-style CSS lookups against a namespace that only defines a bare value now fall through every remaining branch and return undefined instead of the DEFAULT string that the removed branch used to return.
reason: Confirmed in the pack: the added condition ANDs in Array.isArray(resolvedValue), which is always false for the plain object ({DEFAULT: ...}) that a namespace-root bare-value lookup actually produces, and the old else-if that used to unwrap that plain object was deleted, so the function falls through and returns undefined instead of the string.
